As the subject matter expert, a Pharmacist 5 leads in their specialized area of pharmacy practice. In collaboration with teams and leaders, the role assists and is accountable for assisting the department of pharmacy in implementing departmental strategy, optimizing outcomes, achieving financial targets, and ensuring operational excellence. The role serves as a liaison with external stakeholders to work towards achieving department goals. They lead and/or coordinate team members to participate in internal and external committees, subcommittees, and taskforces/workgroups, which may include but not limited to UCOP and P&T. The Pharmacist 5 helps facilitate resident and/or student activities and learnings, as well as lead research and medication evaluations to align with overall departmental needs and goals. This individual is accountable for promoting positive patient outcomes through incorporation of clinical practice, education, system thinking, leadership, and project management.
40% - Operational Excellence

The Specialty Pharmacy Pharmacist Coordinator (Pharmacist 5) leads and completes high-impact project work and initiatives that integrate the work performed by the UCDH Specialty Pharmacy (primarily Health Solutions Pharmacy), the Specialty Pharmacy Hub, and the non-oncology specialty clinic pharmacists. The Specialty Pharmacy Pharmacist Coordinator is tasked with standardization of work and documentation, workflow development, staff training, clinical education development, non-oncology specialty medication onboarding, medication order configuration, electronic health record enhancements (e.g., Epic Compass Rose, order set design, preference lists, smartphrases, etc.), optimizing pharmacy dispensing system build (within Willow Ambulatory), verifying and testing EHR build with the analysts, and other ongoing operational needs for the non-Oncology Specialty Pharmacy teams.
10% - Financial Stability

The Specialty Pharmacy Pharmacist Coordinator (Pharmacist 5) is the clinical content expert for non-oncology specialty pharmacy medications, and works in partnership with UCDH specialty pharmacy leaders (operations & clinical) and analysts to ensure alignment of technician and pharmacist workflows. This individual supports specialty drug onboarding and creates and develops clinical content education when required but not provided by industry partners. Additionally, this individual has committee involvement with UCDH Ambulatory P&T, Specialty Pharmacy QMC, and is the designated Clinical Pharmacist for URAC. This role also supports outcomes and research as it relates to patients enrolled in the URAC Specialty Pharmacy PMP, Rare Disease Program, and other therapy-specialty outcomes relating to clinical pharmacist services.

The individual in this role is expected to collaborate with pharmacy staff on different teams, informatics, medical, pharmacy revenue cycle, and others to implement and maintain safe and cost-effective medication-use systems for Non-Oncology Specialty Pharmacy services. #CA-DS
Analytical and critical thinking abilities to evaluate literature, protocols, and clinical pathways to support evidence-based decision-making and quality improvement

Demonstrated contributions to the development, optimization, and maintenance of patient management program workflows and processes within the electronic health record for chronic disease state management by a pharmacist (i.e., Epic Compass Rose, Therigy, or comparable system)
Strong verbal and written communication skills, interpersonal skills, and a sound work ethic

Demonstrated subject matter expertise in specialty pharmacy, including up-to-date clinical knowledge of specialty therapies, specialty pharmacy workflows and operations, and evolving practice guidelines
Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills

Written and oral communication skills to clearly and concisely provide information, explanations and instructions to, and to elicit information from others with varying levels of ability to understand, including individuals who are ill or distressed, or who may not speak English

Problem-solving skills to independently recognize and define a problem, identify the resources available to help solve the problem, create and implement viable solutions, and follow through to ensure the problem is resolved to the satisfaction of all parties

Skill in leading education and mentorship initiatives, especially as it relates to non-oncology specialty pharmacy and other complex ambulatory therapies, with a track record of successful teaching/precepting residents, students, or staff
Knowledge of regulatory and accreditation requirements for Specialty Pharmacy (e.g., URAC Specialty Pharmacy, URAC Rare Disease, REMS programs, TJC, CA BOP, etc.)
Ability to function effectively in a matrixed environment with a high degree of autonomy, while collaborating across disciplines and service lines
Working knowledge of federal, state and local regulations around medication handling requirement and controlled substance accountability
Working knowledge of prior authorization process, and pharmacy and medical billing
Project management skills, with ability to independently plan, execute, and evaluate multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining clinical practice

Ability to collaborate and work well in a multi-disciplinary team environment, including the ability to manage projects and deadlines, and to set and meet goals and priorities for self and others with minimal supervision

Decision-making skills to independently exercise delegated authority to act, and to recognize when it is appropriate to seek assistance from others when limits of delegated authority have been reached
Ability to exercise discretion to ensure that patient confidentiality is maintained, and a professional, respectful clinic/department environment exists at all times
Ability to maintain composure, efficiency and a positive, customer-service oriented manner during periods of peak workload, with frequent interruptions, under tight deadlines
Ability to coach and mentor pharmacy residents, students, and staff
